questions.q: What is the key difference between a table and a matrix?
options: There is no real difference — they're the same visual with different names
A matrix can't be filtered, while a table can
A matrix supports fields on both rows and columns with automatic aggregation and drill-down, like an Excel PivotTable; a table is a flat grid with no hierarchy
A table can only show text, while a matrix can only show numbers
questions.explain: A table shows one category per row with no hierarchy. A matrix organizes data across multiple dimensions on both rows and columns, similar to a PivotTable.

questions.q: What do the +/- icons on a matrix's row or column headers do?
options: Delete that row or column from the visual
Expand to reveal the next level of detail, or collapse back to a summary
Apply conditional formatting
Sort the matrix alphabetically
questions.explain: When a matrix has more than one field on Rows or Columns, these icons let viewers drill into more detail or collapse back up.

questions.q: What does Auto expand do in a matrix's Row headers / Column headers options?
options: Automatically applies conditional formatting to all values
Removes the need for a Values field well
Automatically resizes the visual to fit the report page
Shows every hierarchy level at once when the visual first loads, instead of requiring a click to expand
questions.explain: Auto expand pre-expands every level of the hierarchy on load, saving viewers from manually clicking + on every header.

questions.q: What happens by default when you scroll a wide matrix horizontally?
options: Row headers stay frozen in place so category labels remain visible
Row headers are hidden entirely
The entire matrix, including row headers, scrolls off screen
The matrix automatically resizes columns to fit
questions.explain: Frozen row headers (the default) keep labels like Year and Quarter visible while only the data columns scroll — this can be turned off under Layout > Freeze.

questions.q: What does a custom total let you do in a matrix or table?
options: Change what the total row displays for a specific column — sum, average, min, max, distinct count, count, or none
Apply a custom color to the total row
Remove the totals row entirely from every visual in the report
Convert the visual into a calculated table
questions.explain: By default the total row evaluates a field across the page's full filter context. Custom totals let you override that per column, right from a right-click menu.
